kind: Author checks; captured live inputs, simulated refresh changes/failures; no source writes

checks.name: Live sources loaded with housekeeping hidden and unclassified visible
Agenda details stay alongside on desktop and become modal on narrow screens
Week strip counts and keyboard-accessible day selection match the agenda
Week Grid remains available and returns to the selected agenda
Unclassified work is accessible separately without crowding the day agenda
Navigation moves week without claiming complete coverage
Search and owner filtering narrow actual records
Housekeeping toggle exposes reviewed rows
Timing inventory does not invent dated grid events
Source text is escaped in cards and details
Refresh moves an event and updates the selected detail
Failed refresh keeps last view with explicit warning
Unavailable source and stale source remain visible
No research launch or source mutation controls
Desktop and narrow viewport fit
